title: 第二十二章 街市风声大陆格局第二十一章 灵狐归形符镇剑煞
content_zh:
厢房结界笼罩四野，屋内静谧无声。
陈默手握阴魄剑，贴身佩戴的下品净心符流转柔和白光，清心之气绵绵不绝，彻底隔绝剑体内翻涌的阴煞戾气。没有了心神反噬的困扰，他全力催动灵力，漆黑剑气纵横屋内，时而隐于虚空毫无踪迹，时而骤然爆发杀伐凌厉，将这柄阴剑诡秘突袭的特点练得愈发纯熟。
一旁小白狐伏在窗台，雪白皮毛干净蓬松，吞噬火莲所得的火焰之力早已彻底炼化，赤红火光在皮毛下随心收放，想显便显、想藏便藏，丝毫没有之前大战后的疲惫。它闭目调息，偶尔抬眼看向练剑的陈默，尾巴轻轻扫动，一人一狐朝夕苦修，实力都在稳步攀升。
午后时分，连日闭关略显枯燥，陈默也恰好丹药见底，便打算出门前往城内街市，采购日常修炼所需的低阶丹药与固本灵草。
他收起阴魄剑，将净心符紧贴胸口衣物，小白狐纵身一跃，安稳趴在他肩头，敛去所有火焰气息，看上去就是一只温顺无害的普通小灵狐。
踏出林家后院，府内氛围已然肉眼可见的紧绷。往日里嬉笑打闹的宗门弟子尽数不见，沿路三步一哨、五步一岗，护卫周身灵力紧绷，眼神警惕地扫视四方，往来弟子皆步履匆匆，闭口不谈闲事，整座林家别院都笼罩在压抑的戒备之中。
陈默不动声色，径直走出府门，踏入青阳城主街。
往日热闹繁华的青阳街市，如今变了一副模样。
街道宽阔，两侧鳞次栉比开满丹药铺、法器行、灵材阁，往日人声鼎沸，商贩吆喝声、修士讨价还价声络绎不绝，往来散修络绎不绝，十分热闹。可如今整条大街冷清大半，不少街边小摊直接撤摊关门，只剩几家老牌店铺勉强开张。
街上行人寥寥，过往修士个个步履匆忙，低头赶路，没人敢驻足闲聊。街边偶尔有三两修士靠墙而立，压低声音窃窃私语，言语之中句句不离最近宗门世家的纷争，神色惶恐不安。
街角茶寮内，客人稀少，偶尔传出几句细碎议论：
“西边灵药山那边动静越来越大了，武家和叶家的人频频出没啊。”
“林家这下麻烦大了，两家联手，怕是不好招架。”
“大宗门不管底下世家恩怨，这次只能林家自己硬扛了……”
风声细碎，满城皆是暗流涌动。
陈默不动声色走入街边装潢古朴的回春丹铺，浓郁醇厚的药香扑面而来。
货架上整齐摆放着各式瓷瓶，分装着淬体丹、固元丹、清淤丹等修士日常刚需的低阶丹药。柜台后，留着山羊胡的中年掌柜正低头擦拭药瓶，见客人进门，抬眸露出一抹客套笑意：“这位小友，需要何种丹药？”
陈默指尖轻点柜台，开口直言：“三瓶固元丹，两瓶清淤丹。”
掌柜快速取出五瓶丹药摆放整齐，微微一笑：“一共八十枚下品灵石。”
听到报价，陈默心底暗自沉吟。

【我身为林家外门弟子，每月固定俸禄只有五十枚下品灵石，平日里修炼耗丹、偶尔购置灵材、还要给小雪准备灵食，本就捉襟见肘。往日这套丹药最多六十五灵石，如今局势动荡，药材运输受阻，店家直接坐地起价，一下子多要十几枚灵石，实在太过黑心。每月俸禄本就微薄，每一枚灵石都要精打细算，根本不能白白多花分毫。】
心中念头转过，陈默面上依旧平静，从容开口还价：“掌柜，近日城内人心惶惶，街上客流锐减，你生意也难做。平日里这套丹药最多六十五灵石，如今乱世将至，我一次性买这么多，七十灵石，一手交钱一手交货。”
掌柜面露为难，搓了搓手：“小友有所不知，如今通往城外灵药产地的道路被各方修士把守，灵材进货价格大涨，我也是没办法才涨价。最低七十五灵石，不能再少了。”
“七十二灵石，成交。”陈默不退不让，语气笃定。
他很清楚当下行情，也明白店家的底价，不想再多浪费一分灵石。毕竟他每月俸禄有限，后续局势紧张，灵石只会越来越难赚，必须省着花销。
content_en:
The boundary of the wing room enveloped the surrounding areas, and the room was silent.
Chen Mo held the Yin Soul Sword in his hand, and the low-grade Pure Heart Talisman worn close to his body emitted soft white light, and the pure heart energy was continuous, completely blocking the Yin evil energy surging within the sword. Without the trouble of mental backlash, he mobilized his spiritual power with all his strength, and the dark sword energy spread across the room, sometimes hiding in the void without a trace, sometimes bursting out with fierce killing power, and he became more and more proficient in the mysterious surprise characteristics of this Yin sword.
The little white fox was lying on the window sill beside him. His snow-white fur was clean and fluffy. The power of the flames gained from devouring the fire lotus had been completely refined. The red fire light spread freely under his fur. He could show off when he wanted and hide when he wanted. There was no trace of fatigue after the previous battle. It closed its eyes and adjusted its breath. Occasionally, it raised its eyes to look at Chen Mo who was practicing the sword. It swept its tail lightly. Each person and the fox practiced hard day and night, and their strength was steadily increasing.
In the afternoon, the days of seclusion were getting a bit boring. Chen Mo also happened to have bottomed out the elixirs, so he planned to go out to the city market to purchase low-level elixirs and root-strengthening spiritual herbs needed for daily practice.
He put away the Yin Soul Sword and held the Pure Heart Talisman close to his chest and clothes. The little white fox jumped up and rested on his shoulder, removing all the flames. It looked like a docile and harmless ordinary little spirit fox.
Stepping out of the Lin family's backyard, the atmosphere in the house was already visibly tense. The sect disciples who used to laugh and play in the past were all gone. There was a sentry every three steps and a post every five steps along the road. The guards' spiritual energy was tense and their eyes were scanning all directions. The disciples walking in and out were in a hurry and kept silent. The entire Lin Family Courtyard was shrouded in oppressive alert.
Chen Mo calmly walked out of the mansion and stepped into the main street of Qingyang City.
The bustling Qingyang Market in the past has now changed.
The street is wide, with rows of elixir shops, magic weapon stores, and spiritual materials pavilions on both sides. In the past, it was bustling with people, vendors shouting, monks bargaining, and casual cultivators coming and going. It was very lively. But now most of the street is deserted, many street stalls have been closed down, and only a few old shops are barely open.
There were only a few people walking on the street. The monks who passed by were all walking in a hurry and keeping their heads down. No one dared to stop and chat. Occasionally, there are three or two monks standing against the wall on the street, whispering in low voices, and their words are not far from the recent disputes between the sects and families, and their expressions are frightened and uneasy.
In the teahouse on the street corner, there were few guests. Occasionally, a few small comments were heard:
"The commotion in the Spiritual Medicine Mountain to the west is getting louder and louder. People from the Wu family and the Ye family appear frequently."
"The Lin family is in big trouble now. If the two families join forces, it will be difficult to fight against them."
"The big sect doesn't care about the grievances of the families below. This time, the Lin family can only bear it..."
There was a soft sound of wind, and there was an undercurrent surging all over the city.
Chen Mo calmly walked into the simple-decorated rejuvenation pill shop on the street, and the rich and mellow medicinal fragrance hit his face.
Various porcelain bottles are neatly placed on the shelves, containing low-level elixirs such as Body Tempering Pill, Solid Yuan Pill, and Cleansing Pill that monks need daily. Behind the counter, the middle-aged shopkeeper with a goatee was wiping the medicine bottle with his head lowered. When he saw the customer coming in, he raised his eyes with a polite smile and said, "What kind of medicine does this little friend need?"
Chen Mo tapped the counter with his fingertips and said bluntly: "Three bottles of Gu Yuan Pill and two bottles of Cleansing Pill."
The shopkeeper quickly took out five bottles of elixirs and arranged them neatly, and smiled slightly: "A total of eighty low-grade spiritual stones."
After hearing the quotation, Chen Mo pondered secretly in his heart.
[As an outside disciple of the Lin family, my monthly fixed salary is only fifty low-grade spiritual stones. On weekdays, I am spending too much on practicing elixirs, occasionally purchasing spiritual materials, and preparing spiritual food for Xiaoxue. In the past, this set of elixirs could only cost up to sixty-five spirit stones. Now that the situation is turbulent and the transportation of medicinal materials is blocked, the store directly raises the price. It is really too sinister to ask for more than a dozen spirit stones at once. The monthly salary is meager, and every spiritual stone must be calculated carefully, and no extra cents can be spent in vain. 】
After turning his thoughts around, Chen Mo's face remained calm and he calmly opened his counteroffer:"Shopkeeper, people in the city have been in panic recently, the number of people on the streets has dropped sharply, and it's hard for you to do business. Normally, this set of elixirs can only go up to sixty-five spiritual stones, but now that troubled times are approaching, I bought so many, seventy spiritual stones, at one time, paying for them with one hand and delivering them with the other."
The shopkeeper looked embarrassed and rubbed his hands: "My friend, I don't know. Now the roads leading to the source of spiritual medicine outside the city are guarded by monks from all walks of life. The purchase price of spiritual materials has risen sharply. I have no choice but to increase the price. The minimum is seventy-five spiritual stones, which cannot be any less."
"Seventy-two spirit stones, deal." Chen Mo refused to give in, his tone was firm.
He is very aware of the current market situation and the store's lowest price, and does not want to waste any more spiritual stones. After all, his monthly salary is limited, and the situation in the future is tense. It will only become harder and harder to earn spiritual stones, so he must save money.
